name: dbt-graphify
description: dbt lineage queries and snapshot history over S3

s3_path.title: S3 path
s3_path.description: S3 location where snapshots are stored, e.g. s3://bucket/project

aws_access_key_id.title: AWS access key ID
aws_access_key_id.description: AWS access key with read access to the S3 bucket

aws_secret_access_key.title: AWS secret access key
aws_secret_access_key.description: AWS secret key paired with the access key ID

aws_region.title: AWS region
aws_region.description: AWS region where the S3 bucket lives, e.g. us-east-1
